identification_strategy: One-line: IV — treatment = number of slaves exported, control = countries with fewer or no slaves exported; shock/instrument/cutoff = sailing distances to slave demand locations

key_variables.treatment: Number of slaves exported from each country
key_variables.control: Countries with fewer or no slaves exported
key_variables.instrument_or_cutoff: Sailing distances from each country to the nearest location of demand for slave labor

conclusion_detail: The slave trades have had an adverse effect on economic development.
main_effect: The IV coefficients are negative and significant.
key_robustness: Historical evidence on selection into slave trades
Examination of pre-slave trade population densities
notes: The confidence is less than 1.0 due to potential unobserved country characteristics that may still bias the estimates.
